migration_and_rollback.projection_note: This packet is research/evidence only. Rollback removes only this record; no executable source or authority changes.

title: Audit duplicated probe-case collection admission across CPU and CUDA Tensor diagnostics

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

question: After GPU-178 centralized Boolean block and pair admission, what is the next exact duplicated contract that can be removed without inventing another Tensor abstraction or moving backend-specific policy into shared Fourfold semantics?

duplicated_rules: reject str/bytes and non-Sequence case collections
require every member to be a ProbeCase
confirmed_duplicate.why_duplicate: Both physical arms repeat the same collection-admission checks verbatim immediately before executing cases, even though the case type and bound already come from the shared contract.

kept_local.cuda_single_dtype_rule: CUDA run_probe additionally requires one dtype per run so device evidence remains unambiguous; this is a CUDA measurement boundary and should remain local after shared collection admission.
kept_local.cpu_sampling_rule: CPU _validate_sampling accepts raw repeats/warmup for execute_bitset and repeated measurement independent of ProbeCase construction. It overlaps ProbeCase bounds but is not selected in this packet because collapsing it safely requires a separate call-surface audit.

audit.parallel_abstraction_check: No second case schema, registry, runner, backend or semantic authority is needed. The smallest owner is one helper inside the already-existing boolean_probe_contract module.

next_bounded_implementation.proposal: Add validate_probe_cases to boolean_probe_contract and make both CPU and CUDA run_probe compose that exact helper before their arm-specific work.
next_bounded_implementation.return_contract: Prefer returning an immutable tuple of admitted ProbeCase values so both arms iterate one normalized bounded collection without adding state.
next_bounded_implementation.cpu_boundary: CPU keeps result construction, runtime metadata and measurement policy local.
next_bounded_implementation.cuda_boundary: CUDA keeps single-dtype, device discovery, blocked evidence, OOM handling and device-memory policy local.
tests: pin CPU and CUDA imports to the same validate_probe_cases function object
prove str/bytes, empty, over-bound and non-ProbeCase collections fail through the shared owner
prove CUDA single-dtype rejection remains local and unchanged

preserved_boundaries.semantic_authority: Fourfold/Forest and TypedRelationBlock remain authoritative; diagnostic collection admission does not create a semantic plane or production Tensor authority.
preserved_boundaries.physical_arms: CPU and CUDA retain their different execution, timing, memory and environment constraints.
preserved_boundaries.evidence: Negative/blocked CUDA outcomes remain first-class evidence; no admission helper may convert blocked execution into success.

pre_head_exact_runs.workflow: Ikarus tensor, Genesis and hopping contracts

research_method: read the adopted Masterplan before selecting work
compared current CPU and CUDA run_probe admission surfaces at the exact branch head
separated exact shared admission from CUDA-only measurement policy
confirmed no code change is required to close the audit itself
verification.full_repository_execution: Complete suite remains workflow_dispatch-only and is not claimed by this research packet.

finding.summary: The next safe gardener seam is the verbatim probe-case collection admission duplicated by CPU and CUDA run_probe. It belongs in the existing shared Boolean probe contract; CUDA's one-dtype-per-run rule must remain local.
finding.negative_result: This packet establishes no speedup, Tensor-Core use, production Tensor adoption, Tensor-vs-Forest superiority, benchmark superiority, Gate progress, OwnerApproval or promotion.
